surfaces.currentBehavior: Implements the backend-neutral exact-receipt local attachment-byte resolver contract and bounded non-sensitive failures without an Attachment-ID-only shortcut.
surfaces.notes: The contract operates only inside an already-open Account runtime. It grants no workspace admission, remote read, rendering, upload, deletion, retention, hosted or production authority.

surfaces: Backend-neutral full-receipt local byte resolution port and bounded failures
securityRequirements: Require the complete immutable receipt and return bytes only after exact queue and ciphertext reverification
syncRequirements: Local resolution creates no ps_crud work, Sync Stream, remote fallback or success transition

migration.rule: Use synthetic bytes and disposable target-local fixtures only.
reconciliation: A requested accepted receipt resolves to its exact bytes or one bounded fail-closed outcome without consuming evidence

acceptance: Exact identity, restart, corruption, cancellation and runtime-close tests pass without byte/path/key leakage

surfaces.currentBehavior: Implements provider-free exact-receipt attachment-byte resolution contract and stable non-sensitive diagnostic-code tests.
surfaces.notes: Tests define the narrow local contract only and cannot prove Account authorization lease, physical-device durability, hosted Storage, upload, rendering or production behavior.

surfaces: Provider-free exact-receipt local byte-resolution contract tests
securityRequirements: Prove scope-first refusal and stable non-sensitive diagnostics
syncRequirements: Prove resolution is non-consuming and has no remote or synchronization effect

migration.rule: Use only synthetic identities, receipts and bytes.
reconciliation: Each success and failure maps to one exact contract result without inferring production authority

acceptance: The complete backend-neutral contract test matrix passes before provider integration is promoted
